6669.title: Usage throttling has no shared cooldown
6669.rootCauseOneLine: The provider drops Retry-After, server errors have zero TTL, and the resource overwrites good windows with an uncached error.
6669.proposedFix: Define shared bounded throttling backoff and an explicit last-successful stale-value contract across provider and server boundaries.
6669.caveats: Deterministic synthetic HTTP and host RPC responses; no live Anthropic, macOS, or third-party CLI verification. No automatic fix because the full repair needs contract and policy decisions.
